name: Text as a whole
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2021/1057 establishing the European Social Fund + (ESF+) as regards specific measures to address strategic challenges
part_text:
The European Parliament wants to let countries move part of their European Social Fund money to new priorities: skills for the defence industry and training for workers affected by the shift to a greener economy. It also wants extra money paid upfront to countries, and more still for regions near Russia, Belarus or Ukraine. At the same time, it insists the fund keeps its main social goals and that workers' rights are respected.

- Countries can shift at least 10% of a programme's money to these new priorities and get extra upfront payments.
- Regions bordering Russia, Belarus or Ukraine get 9.5% upfront and up to 95% EU funding.
- Parliament's position now goes to talks with EU governments, which must agree the final text.
